title: Torsion-free coherent modules on regular curves are locally free
statement: Let $X$ be an integral [def-pc-integral-scheme] regular scheme of topological dimension at most one and let $\mathcal F$ be a coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent]. Then $\mathcal F$ is torsion-free if and only if it is finite locally free. The rank of this locally free module is constant and equals $\dim_{k(X)}\mathcal F_\eta$ at the generic point $\eta$, where $k(X)$ is the function field [def-sc-function-field].
